params.name: documentType
params.description: Required with id for an initial read. Omit when continuing with cursor.

params.name: id
params.description: Required with documentType for an initial read. Omit when continuing with cursor.

params.name: representation
params.description: Initial-read representation. Omit when continuing with cursor.

params.name: maxChars
params.description: Maximum characters returned in this response.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque continuation token from meta.nextCursor. May be combined only with maxChars.

params.name: pageStart
params.description: First PDF page to read, inclusive. Omit when continuing with cursor.

params.name: pageEnd
params.description: Last PDF page to read, inclusive. Omit when continuing with cursor.

items.docs: Reads a bounded portion of an authorized document without creating an analysis or enqueueing extraction work. Start a read with documentType and id. Continue when meta.hasMore is true by sending only meta.nextCursor and, optionally, maxChars. Cursors are opaque, source-bound, and re-authorized on every request. Opportunity document IDs are OppAttachment.id values returned as opportunity attachment id; access is derived from any associated opportunity/source path visible to the caller rather than

Returns a fresh presigned URL for the authorized original file. The URL expires at data.expiresAt. This operation is separate from document_read so reading representations never downloads the full file implicitly.
